title: Dual antioxidant activity and the related mechanisms of a novel pentapeptide GLP4 from the fermented mycelia of Ganoderma lingzhi.
authors: Huang, Ping; Luo, Fei-Jun; Ma, You-Chu; Wang, Si-Xian; Huang, Jia; Qin, Dan-Dan; Xue, Fei-Fei; Liu, Bi-Yang; Wu, Qiang; Wang, Xiao-Ling; Liu, Gao-Qiang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究灵芝发酵菌丝中抗氧化肽GLP4的活性与机制，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作（PGAM5）和分子对接，但核心对象非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Oxidative stress causes chronic inflammation, and mediates various diseases. The discovery of antioxidants from natural sources is important to research. Here we identified a novel antioxidant peptide (GLP4) from Ganoderma lingzhi mycelium and investigated its antioxidant type and potential protective mechanisms. Through free radical scavenging assay, active site shielding validation, superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity assay, and lipid peroxidation assay, we demonstrated that GLP4 was a novel protective agent with both direct and indirect antioxidant activities. GLP4 could directly enter human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs) as an exogenous substance. Meanwhile, GLP4 promoted the nuclear translocation of nuclear factor erythroid-2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) and activated the Nrf2/antioxidant response element (ARE) signaling pathway, exhibiting antioxidant and anti-apoptotic cytoprotective effects on hydrogen peroxide (H(2)O(2))-induced HUVECs. Pull-down experiments of GLP4 target proteins, bioinformatics analysis and molecular docking further revealed that GLP4 mediated Nrf2 activation through binding to phosphoglycerate mutase 5 (PGAM5). The results suggested that GLP4 is a novel peptide with dual antioxidant activity and has promising potential as a protective agent in preventing oxidative stress-related diseases.
abstract_zh: 氧化应激引发慢性炎症，并介导多种疾病。从天然来源中发现抗氧化剂对研究具有重要意义。本研究从灵芝菌丝体中鉴定出一种新型抗氧化肽（GLP4），并探讨了其抗氧化类型及潜在的保护机制。通过自由基清除实验、活性位点屏蔽验证、超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）活性测定和脂质过氧化测定，我们证明GLP4是一种兼具直接和间接抗氧化活性的新型保护剂。GLP4能作为外源性物质直接进入人脐静脉内皮细胞（HUVECs）。同时，GLP4促进核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）的核转位，并激活Nrf2/抗氧化反应元件（ARE）信号通路，对过氧化氢（H(2)O(2)）诱导的HUVECs表现出抗氧化和抗凋亡的细胞保护作用。GLP4靶蛋白的Pull-down实验、生物信息学分析和分子对接进一步揭示，GLP4通过与磷酸甘油酸变位酶5（PGAM5）结合来介导Nrf2激活。结果表明，GLP4是一种具有双重抗氧化活性的新型肽，在预防氧化应激相关疾病方面具有作为保护剂的广阔潜力。
